Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this match and we bid adieu to Dominica. There is one more match left in the three-match T20I series and with the first match being washed out, there's still all to play for in the last game. West Indies have the lead and will look to make it 2-0, whilst Bangladesh can only manage to make it 1-1. The final game will be played on Thursday, the 7th of July in Guyana. That match will begin at 11 pm IST (5.30 pm GMT) but our build-up will begin much sooner. Do join us then. Take care and goodbye!

Nicholas Pooran, the captain of West Indies says that as a batting group they were just taking it over by over and they wanted to bat deep. Adds that they had plans to put bowlers under pressure early on as that sets the tone and they have been doing exactly that. Mentions that all the bowlers bowled well, even the spinner from Bangladesh did well on this wicket. Mentions that they have been managing workload well, and he is happy to see other players stepping up. Concludes by saying that the fans at Windsor Park are the best in the Caribbean.

Bangladesh skipper, Mahmudullah says that they didn't start well enough with the ball, allowing the opposition to gain control and Rovman Powell took the game away at the death. Adds that Shakib Al Hasan batted well but the rest of the batting wasn't up to the mark. Mentions that they need to be positive from the start and take advantage of the Powerplay but it didn't happen. Adds that sometimes a break can help you to improve but he hopes that that isn't the case for him personally.

Rovman Powell (61* off 28 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his quickfire knock. He says that his plan was simple, he was trying to get himself in at first and then play the big shots. He praises Brandon King and Nicholas Pooran for the way they batted at the top. Adds that it was a really good wicket and he wishes all the T20I matches were held at this venue only for the fans. He credits his batting coach for improvement in his batting. Further says that their bowlers' execution was good, they spoke about getting wickets in the Powerplay and they did get those wickets. Concludes by thanking all the fans who came to support them.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Nicholas Pooran won the toss and opted to put runs on the board which his side managed to do so. Brandon King at the top was solid and batted through for a long time, allowing others to play the big shots. It was really the blistering knock of Rovman Powell and a few lusty blows from the lower middle order that propelled West Indies to a big score of 193. For Bangladesh, Mahedi Hasan was tidy with the ball and Shoriful Islam showed good skills at the death but that was it. Chasing a daunting target, the visitors never really were able to get a hold of the game and they had mostly themselves to blame. The Windies put in a complete performance and took the win and the lead in the series as well. Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony.

Bangladesh will not be pleased with that batting display. The top-order just doesn't seem to take responsibility for setting the tone whether it be a Test match or a T20I match. Three early wickets fell and there was some resistance from Shakib Al Hasan and Afif Hossain before the latter threw away the good start. Shakib stayed on till the end and having scored a half-century, went berserk as well but it was a little too late. The visitors will rue the middle phase where they couldn't get the boundaries and were blown out of the competition with more than a few overs to spare. A lot to ponder upon then for the visitors.

West Indies had the runs on the board and just needed a couple of wickets inside the Powerplay. They achieved that target and then some, leaving the opposition reeling. Obed McCoy was the star with the ball early on and then in the middle overs, the spin duo of Akeal Hosein and Hayden Walsh kept the scoring rate in check. The hosts picked up a few timely wickets as well and always seemed in control of proceedings in the middle. They will however look to improve at the death as the pacers did get peppered a bit with the game already in the bag.

A huge roar from the crowd at Windsor Park in Roseau as West Indies stroll to victory here and have now taken an unassailable 1-0 lead in the series with just one more game remaining. Just like in the Test series, the hosts have completely dominated the opposition to notch up a well-deserved win.
A well-direct yorker from Romario Shepherd on the last delivery of the game! Shakib Al Hasan digs it out towards cover and takes a run. West Indies win by 35 runs!
Wide of off, fuller ball. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and tries to slash this one but he fails to get any connection.
Wide! Romario Shepherd errs in line again, as he serves it down the leg side. Shakib Al Hasan tries to flick this but he misses. Another wide called!
Lovely ball! Right in the blockhole, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan squeezes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Too full, down the leg side. Shakib Al Hasan misses his flick and a wide is given!
On the pads now, pitches it up again. Mahedi Hasan flicks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Mahedi Hasan gets off the mark with a cracking shot! Full, outside off. Mahedi Hasan drives it off the front foot through extra-cover for a boundary.
Mahedi Hasan is in at number 8.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Romario Shepherd strikes and gets rid of Mosaddek Hossain! A fuller one, angling across, outside off. Mosaddek Hossain tries to play across the line as looks to heave this over mid-wicket but he manages to get a thick outside edge back to the keeper. Nicholas Pooran makes no mistakes as he takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: Romario Shepherd to bowl the final over of the game. Also, just like their counterparts West Indies are behind the required time frame for completing the innings. They can only have 4 fielders outside the circle.

SIX! Short, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan pulls this high over deep square leg for a biggie. 20 runs off that over a big one. Also, that brings up the 50-run stand between these two. A little too late though. 44 needed off the last over!

DROPPED AND FOUR! Some luck for Bangladesh! Another good-length delivery, around middle and off. Shakib Al Hasan heaves it to Hayden Walsh at deep mid-wicket. He goes for the catch but makes a mess of it as the ball goes through his hand towards the boundary for a four.
Outside off, a length delivery. Mosaddek Hossain pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
On a length, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan drags it towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! KABOOM! They need way, way more of these! Lovely shot! On a length, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan dispatched this one high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Width on offer, short in length. Shakib Al Hasan cuts it deep point for a brace. That brings up Shakib Al Hasan's fifty!
SIX! BOOM! Good finish to the over for Bangladesh! Short and wide of off. Mosaddek Hossain cuts it high over backward point for a biggie.
Wide! Down the leg side, fullish ball. Mosaddek Hossain misses his flick. Wide called!
Excellent fielding yet again! Length ball from Smith, this is thumped wide of sweeper cover. Keemo Paul speeds to his right from the cover fence and cuts it off. The batters get a couple of runs.
Excellent fielding! Fuller one, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it towards deep cover. Hayden Walsh runs quickly to his left and makes a good stop. Two taken!
FOUR! Short and wide, Shakib Al Hasan throws his bat at it and gets it over backward point to find the fence.
Another swing and a miss! A similar delivery to the previous one. Fuller, outside off, at around 138 clicks. Shakib Al Hasan looks to hoick this over mid-wicket but he misses again.
Play and a miss! Fullish, this one shapes away as well, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan swings his bat at it but he fails to get any connection.
Slower one, a length ball, around middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan works it away towards long on for a single. 78 needed off 18 balls.
Back of a length, around middle. Mosaddek Hossain flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Tight single! Yorker, around middle and off. Shakib Al Hasan digs it out onto the deck and scampers across to the other end.
SIX! There it is! Finally! A much-needed one for Bangladesh. A length ball, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan hoicks this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Swing and a miss! A touch slower, at around 119 clicks, outside off, on a length. Shakib Al Hasan tries to heave this one but he misses. It's been 45 balls since the last boundary came in!
Wide yorker from Obed McCoy. Mosaddek Hossain reaches out to it and pushes it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Obed McCoy (2-0-7-2) is back into the attack.
Very full, around middle and off. Mosaddek Hossain makes room and drives it towards cover for yet another run. 88 needed off 24 balls!
Cheeky! Full again, around off. Shakib Al Hasan shuffles across the off pole, and scoops it just over the man at short third man. Single taken!
Pitches it up, around middle and leg. Mosaddek Hossain backs away and strikes it down to long on. Only a single!

He goes over the wicket now to the left-hander, serves a low full toss around middle. Shakib Al Hasan knocks it down to long off for another run. Singles are not helping Bangladesh here! They need boundaries and plenty of them!
Very full now from 'round the wicket, around middle. Mosaddek Hossain flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Romario Shepherd errs in line now, and serves a fuller one down the leg side. Mosaddek Hossain misses his flick and a wide is called!
A yorker-length delivery, around off. Shakib Al Hasan digs it out towards point for a single.
Romario Shepherd (2-0-13-1) comes back to bowl.

A bit flighted and on a driving length outside off. Shakib Al Hasan just strokes it through extra cover for one more. Still no boundary since the 9th over and the task gets all that more difficult for Bangladesh.
A touch shorter, on the pads. Mosaddek Hossain flicks it off the back foot and past square leg for a run.
On a shortish length and around off, this is played off the back foot and onto the leg side.
Mosaddek Hossain walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pressure is telling on the Bangladeshi batters now as Nurul Hasan holes out. Akeal Hosein drags it down and bowls it on middle. Nurul has the ball to hit for the boundary but he fails to take advantage. Nurul is early in the pull shot and flat-bats it straight down the throat of Brandon King at the square leg fence. King makes no mistake and Akeal Hosein has his man. 97 needed now off 33 balls and it's almost game over for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Howout: c Brandon King b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter again and around off, this is tapped over the bowler's head for a single.
WIDE! Tries to fire it in wide outside off but spills it beyond the tramline. Wide called.
Quicker and flatter, outside off. This is played off the back foot towards cover-point for one.

In the air...but safe! Nicely flighted, around middle and leg. Nurul Hasan gets down on his knees to sweep but ends up getting a top edge. The ball loops up and lands just beyond the reach of the man at backward square leg. Single taken.
Short and wide, this is cut away towards deep point for one.
Tossed up, full and around middle, This is driven along the ground towards long off for just another single.
A bit flatter and around off, Nurul Hasan opens the face of the bat and steers it towards short third man.
Around off, this is knocked down to long off for a run.

Almost gets chopped on! Shorter and around off, this one turns away as it's the googly. Shakib Al Hasan looks to cut but gets an inside edge which luckily for him doesn't go back on to hit the stumps.
On a shorter length and outside off. Nurul Hasan dabs it down towards backward point.
Floats this one up, wide of off stump. Shakib Al Hasan drives but manages to pick up just a single towards deep cover.
On a length and on middle, this is worked away in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Flatter delivery, around off, this is played off the back foot onto the off side for just a single.
A touch shorter and angled across the off stump, Shakib fails to get it away on the off side.

Quick single and West Indies once again concede an overthrow! Flatter delivery, around off. This is tapped towards cover-point for a quick run and the throw at the keeper's end is a bit wide. This allows Shakib to come back for the second.
Akeal Hosein comes back into the attack.
Short again, around leg stump. Shakib tucks it away past square leg for one more.
On a shorter length, around off. This is eased off the back foot through cover for a run.

NOT OUT! This is bowled on a length, around off and this one seems to be the googly. Nurul Hasan puts a big stride forward but misses the defensive block and gets struck on the pads. Hayden Walsh likes it and Nicholas Pooran asks him if it's too high. Just as the clock runs down, Pooran takes the review. UltraEdge is checked first and we can see that there is an inside edge on it, review lost then for West Indies.
Around off, this is stroked away towards the cover region for one more. Bangladesh are in desperate need of boundaries here.
Flighted this time, full and on off. Nurul pushes it past a diving Hayden Walsh for a single.
Nicely slowed up and floated well outside off, Shakib looks to heave it across the line but checks his shot. This is played towards extra cover for a single.
Lovely! On a perfect length and close to the off pole. Nurul Hasan tries to run it fine but the ball zips past the outside edge. End of a successful over from Shepherd, 3 runs and a wicket off it.
This is drifted onto the pads, Shakib flicks it behind square on the leg side and rotates the strike.
Back of a length and close to the off pole, Nurul Hasan taps it through cover for a single.
Full and straight, pushed away towards mid on.
Nurul Hasan is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Tries to be a bit too cheeky here Afif Hossain and pays the ultimate price. Another length ball from Romario Shepherd, over middle and leg. Afif shuffles past the off stump and tries to get inside the line and scoop it over the keeper. The ball goes off the gloves and straight into Nicholas Pooran's mitts. Shepherd breaks the partnership and the hosts are back on top of proceedings. 116 needed now off 58 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, around off, Shakib backs away and cuts it down towards third man for a single.
Romario Shepherd is back on.

Another overthrow! Shorter, outside off. Afif Hossain pushes it towards cover and takes a risky single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but the fielder misses. Another overthrow and the batters take another run. Bangladesh are 77 for 3 at the halfway mark.
A JAFFA! Sower through the air, loopy one, a googly as well, around off. Afif Hossain tries to flick this but gets beaten on the outside edge.

Fraction shorter, around middle and off. Shakib Al Hasan drags it with the inner half of his bat towards the left of the bowler. Hayden Walsh dives to catch the ball but the ball falls just short of him. It goes towards mid off and a single is taken!
Full again, around middle and leg. Afif Hossain clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
An appeal from the bowler for an LBW, but not given! Full, on middle. Afif Hossain tries to rever-sweep this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan lifts it straight down the ground. Not the perfect timing on that one. The fielder from long on will cut it out. Single taken!
Back of a length, outside off, a tad quicker as well. Afif Hossain tries to guide this one towards third man but he misses.
SIX! BANG! Poor delivery and punished! Short, on middle. Afif Hossain swivels and pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Down the leg side, fuller one. Afif Hossain tries to sweep this but he gets a slight inside edge towards fine leg. Obed McCoy does well to keep the ball away from the ropes. Two taken!
Shorter one, outside off. Afif Hossain pushes it off the back foot towards the fielder at short cover.
Leg bye! Pitches it up, darting it on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan tries to flick this but he misses. The ball deflects off his pads and goes towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken!
Back of a length, at 84 clicks, outside off. Afif Hossain stays in his crease and cuts it past point for a single.
Another fuller ball, darting it on the pads. Afif Hossain flicks it in the vacant mid-wicket region and takes a run.
Slower through the air, full again, on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan clips it off the front foot towards mid-wicket. Single taken!
Pitches it up again, on middle and leg. Afif Hossain presses forward and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! Lovely shot by Afif Hossain. A fuller one, on middle. Afif Hossain reverse-sweeps this over point for a boundary.
Tosses it up this time, fuller, around middle. Afif Hossain tries to flick this but he gets a leading edge away from the fielder at point.
Hayden Walsh begins with a shorter ball, a googly, wide of off. Afif Hossain pushes it off the back foot towards deep cover for a brace.
Hayden Walsh is on.
Fuller, around off. Afif Hossain pushes it towards mid off for a quick single. He retains the strike!

Overthrows! Short again, around off. Afif Hossain steps down the wicket and taps it to the right of the fielder at point. They run across to the other end. Hayden Walsh there has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. There is no backing up which means the batters run an extra run as well!
Back of a length, outside off. Afif Hossain stays in his crease and dabs it towards point.
Keemo Paul goes fuller on this occasion, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it firmly to the fielder at cover. Hayden Walsh fumbles there and the batters sneak in a single!
FOUR! Up and over! Short and wide of off. Shakib Al Hasan rocks back and cuts it over backward point for a boundary.
Wide! A length ball, very wide this time. Shakib Al Hasan offers no shot again. Wide called!
Keemo Paul starts off with a fuller one, wide of off, at 139 clicks. Shakib Al Hasan leaves it alone.
Keemo Paul is now brought into the attack.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Pitches it up again, on the pads. Afif Hossain flicks it behind square on the leg side this time. Bangladesh are 44 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay!
FOUR! Nicley done! Full again, outside off. Afif Hossain slices it behind square on the off side for a boundary!

Pitches it up again, around middle. Afif Hossain pushes it towards mid on and scampers across to the other end. Obed McCoy misses his shy at the bowler's end and the batters pick up an overthrow as well!
Well bowled! Change of pace this time, at 109 clicks, outside off, fuller one. Afif Hossain misses his drive once again!
On a length, around off, a bit of extra bounce there as well! Afif Hossain does well to keep it out towards cover.
Romario Shepherd starts off with a fuller ball, shaping away, outside off, at 133 clicks. Afif Hossain looks to drive this away from his body but he misses.
Romario Shepherd comes into the attack.
Around the hips, this is helped on its way towards fine leg for a single. 160 needed now off 90 deliveries.
Sweetly timed but straight to the fielder. Full and around off, Afif Hossain with a classy cover drive but he can't find the gap.
Goes fuller this time and on off, pushed back towards the bowler.
A tad shorter and around off, Shakib looks to repeat the trick but this time just steers it past point for one.
FOUR! Clever from Shakib Al Hasan! Length and outside off, Shakib just walks past the off stump and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
That must have stung! A heavy ball from Odean Smith, over off stump. Shakib Al Hasan awkwardly tries to fend off the extra bounce but misses and takes a blow to the mid-riff.
Back of a length, angling into middle and leg. Shakib hops and works it through mid-wicket for a single.

On a good length and angling in from around off. A bit of an extra bounce on this occasion as Shakib tries to work it leg side. The ball goes off the leading edge but falls safely around the short cover region.
Around the top of off, blocked from inside the crease by Shakib.
Sent back! Length, around off, this is pushed towards cover and Shakib wants the single. His partner though sends him back.
FOUR! Nicely played! Just short of a length, a fair bit outside off. Shakib goes deep in the crease and just sort of chips it with control over the gully region for a boundary.
Short and wide but shaping away a touch, Shakib Al Hasan tries to cut it but misses.
Afif Hossain comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Catastrophic for Bangladesh as the skipper throws it away! This is pitched up, outside off. Mahmudullah advances and tries to thump it over mid off. Mahmudullah hits it firmly but doesn't get the elevation. Probably the tallest man on the field, Obed McCoy jumps up a bit to his right and snatches it. A sharp catch from McCoy and Smith has the last laugh. Bangladesh are three down now, still needing a lot of runs to win.
Commentary.Howout: c Obed McCoy b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Much better from Smith. Back of a length, much closer to the off pole, This is punched off the back foot towards cover.
WIDE! Odean Smith is all over the pace at the moment. Length ball, way outside the off stump. Wide called.
FOUR! Again it's a bit short and now there's ample width on offer as well. Mahmudullah waits a bit and slices it over the point fielder to collect a boundary.

SIX! Mahmudullah made that look very easy. This is banged in a bit short and at the body, Mahmudullah just leans back a bit and nonchalantly plays the pick-up shot, dispatching the ball all the way over the backward square leg fence for a biggie.
WIDE! This is pushed wider, a bit too wider though.
Over the wicket now to the right-hander, short of a length and around off. Mahmudullah defends it out.

Leg bye! Smith starts from around the wicket and hits the hard length, angling it into the pads. Shakib Al Hasan hosp back and gets pinged high on the pads. The ball pops up towards backward point as the batters sneak in a leg bye.
Odean Smith is introduced into the attack.
Length this time, round middle and leg, this is worked away through mid-wicket for a single. Just 2 runs and a couple of wickets off McCoy's first over.
Back of a length, on off and just angling in a bit. Shakib Al Hasan stays on the back foot and nudges it down towards the gully region.
The skipper is off the mark! Short of a length and on off, Mahmudullah hops back and keeps it down towards backward point for a run.
No hat-trick! Full and a bit wide, allowing the batter the opportunity to leave it. A bit poor from Obed McCoy but it is still a dot ball.
Mahmudullah the skipper of Bangladesh walks out to face the hat-trick ball!

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Obed McCoy has two-in-two and he is on a roll here! Goes full and wide this time, Anamul Haque looks to drive it through the covers but there is minimal feet movement. Haque has to reach out for it a bit and ends up getting an inside edge back onto the stumps. McCoy is absolutely delighted as Bangladesh continue to lose early wickets at the top. McCoy will be on a hat-trick.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lazy, lazy shot from Litton Das and he perishes early. Obed McCoy starts off with a regulation length ball, around middle stump. Das gets in a good position to clip it off his legs but just doesn't follow through all that well. Das plays a checked-shot and lofts it towards the square leg fence. Shamarh Brooks over there takes a simple catch and McCoy draws first blood!
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: Who will bowl from the other end? Obed McCoy it is!
Floated up, on the pads, this is nudged away towards square leg. 8 runs come off the first over then.

SAFE! Risky single but no harm is done. On middle, Das presses forward and plays it with soft hands towards square leg. The batters set off for the run and the throw is fired in at the keeper's end. Nicholas Pooran whips off the bails and it is sent upstairs. The replay shows that Anamul Haque is well in.
Fuller in length and on middle, Das pushes it to the right of the bowler.
FOUR! Nice way to get off the mark! Flatter delivery, around off. Litton Das rocks back and just opens the face of the bat to cut it behind point for a boundary.
Flighted, on middle, Haque looks to drive inside-out but miscues it towards mid on for a single.

Positive intent from Anamul Haque right from the off. Akeal Hosein tosses it up first up, on middle and leg, Haque makes room and drives it through covers for a couple of runs. Bangladesh are underway!
